answer: A Reef-anchor sponsor-decay bond stops bulk fake identities: a newcomer joins only when a sponsor anchors it to the reef, staking reputation and a 70-credit bond. That reputation cools like an ember, fading 5% per idle epoch; a sybil forfeits the bond and bars its sponsor 20 epochs. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 credits vs at most 40,000 in rewards, and a rented-anchor ring burns its anchors. One sponsor and one refundable bond admit an honest agent.
